en.headline: Huanggang port to open as soon as Hong Kong and Shenzhen confirm smooth operations
en.dek: Immigration chief Benson Kwok said no date is fixed yet, but both sides want to open the rebuilt checkpoint as soon as operations are confirmed smooth, including before National Day if conditions allow.
body: Director of Immigration Benson Kwok said Hong Kong and Shenzhen will set an opening date for the rebuilt Huanggang Port only after both sides confirm it can operate safely, smoothly and efficiently. Asked whether the checkpoint could open before the National Day Golden Week, he said the shared aim is to open as early as possible if operations are genuinely smooth.

Kwok, speaking on a radio programme on Saturday, said the two sides are fine-tuning computer systems so that the co-located “co-inspection, one-time clearance” model can run faster. He said self-service channels are designed to complete both sides’ immigration checks in about 20 seconds, though first-time users must agree to share document, facial and fingerprint data with the receiving side.

He said the port is expected to handle about 200,000 crossings a day at the start, rising to about 300,000 after a rail link is in place. Opening-day traffic of 100,000 or more is “far from impossible”, he said, because some travellers now using Heung Yuen Wai, the Lok Ma Chau Spur Line or Shenzhen Bay may switch to try the new facilities.

Kwok said extra staff have been assigned and more than 100 retired officers have been hired on contract to support the opening. He added that the 20,000-strong stress tests, including a cross-boundary drill on 29 August, showed the systems working as planned, but a formal date will wait until both governments are satisfied.

zh.headline: 郭俊峯：皇崗口岸待港深確認暢順後盡早開通
zh.dek: 入境處處長表示未敲定開通日期，但若運作暢順會盡早啟用，不排除趕及國慶黃金周前；初期料每日可處理約20萬人次。
body: 入境事務處處長郭俊峯表示，新皇崗口岸須待港深雙方確認具備安全、暢順及高效運作條件後，才會敲定正式開通日期。被問到能否趕及國慶黃金周前啟用，他說兩地共同目標是盡早開通，若真正可以順暢運作，便會盡早開通。
郭俊峯周六在電台節目表示，雙方正微調電腦系統，以提高「合作查驗、一次放行」的速度。他指自助通道目標約20秒完成兩邊出入境手續，旅客首次使用須同意把證件、容貌及指紋資料傳給入境一方，其後可選擇以面容通關。
他預計口岸啟用初期每日可承載約20萬出入境人次，待鐵路接駁後可提升至約30萬。他認為開通初期會受歡迎，部分原本使用香園圍、落馬洲支線或深圳灣口岸的旅客或會轉來試用，首日或首階段達10萬人次以上絕非不可能。
人手方面，郭俊峯說已調配額外人員，並聘請逾百名退休人員以合約形式支援。他指早前包括8月29日在內的大型演練及跨境壓力測試中，系統運作正常，但正式日期仍須待兩地政府確認條件合適後公布。
